invariants.rationale: The method returns a HoodieWriteMetadata object, which should not be null under normal circumstances.
The list of WriteStatus objects in the metadata should not be null after deletion.
The getWriteStatuses() method of HoodieWriteMetadata should return a List.
The instantTime should be a non-null, non-empty String identifying the instant.
The list of keys provided for deletion should not be null.
